findings.issue: Source files written as single large bash heredocs caused a truncated write, a write into a missing directory, an immediately-discarded draft of home.ts, and a Python patch that duplicated a block in app/src/pages/pokemon.ts.
findings.suggestion: Write files incrementally (or via a proper write/edit mechanism), and prefer targeted edits over whole-file replaces when patching.

findings.issue: The sort-test fix makes the th itself carry data-key (robust to the click race the agent observed) but the underlying double-render that made the button count 0 at click time was never root-caused.
findings.suggestion: Trace why the moves content re-renders after the header is visible (likely a second render pass after move records resolve) so the race can be eliminated rather than tolerated.

findings.issue: Debug probe script was created in /tmp where @playwright/test could not resolve, then hit a strict-mode locator violation before producing useful output.
findings.suggestion: Place probe scripts inside the repo (or resolve from the root package) and scope locators to the specific table under test from the start.

findings.issue: Data-shape probes guessed file layout (species stored under name directories) and dict keys, producing two tracebacks before adapting to id-based paths.
findings.suggestion: List the directory structure once before probing individual records.
